does: Answers whether a creature may act on its turn: no for a dead or incapacitated one, and no for a character holding an active status whose id is the fixed string SURPRISED - the status's name itself, apart from its boosts, ends the turn.

evidence.says: the decompiler's name of the function comes from the Toolkit's export, matched by calls
the walk of the character's statuses returns false on a status of type 3 other than one named id, and on the id SURPRISED
a surprised creature's turn, a human's or the player's own character's, ends 30 ticks after it began with no action and no input

questions.ask: A probe on it while a surprised creature's turn begins would show who asks; a status given another name with the same four boosts would show whether the name alone ends the turn.
